PryceText_Intro:
#MON have many
experiences in

their lives, just 
like we do. 

I, too, have seen
and suffered much in my life.

Since I am your
elder, let me show you what I mean.

I have been with
#MON since

before you were
born.

I do not lose
easily.

I, PRYCE--the
winter trainer--

shall demonstrate
my power!
PryceText_Impressed:
Ah, I am impressed
by your prowess.

With your strong
will, I know you

will overcome all
life's obstacles.

You are worthy of
this BADGE!
PryceText_GlacierBadgeSpeech:
That BADGE will
raise the SPECIAL stats of #MON.

It also lets your
#MON use WHIRL- POOL to get across real whirlpools.

And this… This is
a gift from me!
PryceText_IcyWindSpeech:
That TM contains
ICY WIND.

It inflicts damage
and lowers speed.

It demonstrates
the harshness of winter.
PryceText_CherishYourPokemon:
When the ice and
snow melt, spring arrives.

You and your #-
MON will be to-

gether for many
years to come.

Cherish your time
together!
BoarderRonaldSeenText:
I'll freeze your
#MON, so you can't do a thing!
BoarderRonaldBeatenText:
Darn. I couldn't
do a thing.
BoarderRonaldAfterBattleText:
I think there's a
move a #MON

can use while it's
frozen.
BoarderBradSeenText:
This GYM has a
slippery floor.

It's fun, isn't
it?

But hey--we're
not playing games here!
BoarderBradBeatenText:
Do you see how
serious we are?
BoarderBradAfterBattleText:
This GYM is great.
I love boarding with my #MON!
BoarderDouglasBeatenText:
OK. I'll tell you
PRYCE's secret.
BoarderDouglasAfterBattleText:
The secret behind
PRYCE's power…

He meditates under
a waterfall daily

to strengthen his
mind and body.
SkierRoxanneSeenText:
To get to PRYCE,
our GYM LEADER,

you need to think
before you skate.
SkierRoxanneBeatenText:
I wouldn't lose to
you in skiing!
SkierRoxanneAfterBattleText:
If you don't skate
with precision,

you won't get far
in this GYM.
SkierClarissaBeatenText:
No! You made me
wipe out!
SkierClarissaAfterBattleText:
I shouldn't have
been bragging about my skiing…
MahoganyGymGuideText:
PRYCE is a veteran
who has trained

#MON for some
50 years.

He's said to be
good at freezing

opponents with
ice-type moves.

That means you
should melt him

with your burning
ambition!
MahoganyGymGuideWinText:
PRYCE is some-
thing, but you're something else!

That was a hot
battle that

bridged the gen-
eration gap!
